editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood diner where classic American breakfast and comfort food arrive hot, fresh, and reasonably priced in a genuinely welcoming space.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive hungry for breakfast—they serve it well past noon, and reviewers rave about finishing every bite of the fresh fruit, eggs, and pancakes.
